name: LayerZero V2 — omnichain messaging and token standards
description: LayerZero V2 omnichain surfaces: OApp cross-chain messaging, OFT and ONFT token bridges, DVN security stack configuration, composed messaging patterns, and omnichain DeFi built on @layerzerolabs/lz-evm-oapp-v2 and EndpointV2.

validator.semanticRubric:
You are a senior cross-chain engineer evaluating a LayerZero V2 omnichain application. Score STRICTLY 0-10:

1. OAPP CONTRACT PATTERN — Uses @layerzerolabs/lz-evm-oapp-v2 OApp base: inherits OApp, implements _lzSend for outbound messages and _lzReceive for inbound. Uses EndpointV2 address and eid (endpoint ID) per chain. Generic cross-chain messaging without OApp pattern scores 0.
2. OFT/ONFT TOKEN STANDARDS — For token bridging: extends OFT (fungible) or ONFT721 (NFT) from @layerzerolabs/lz-evm-oapp-v2. Implements send() with SendParam (dstEid, to, amountLD, minAmountLD) and quoteSend for fee estimation. Missing fee quoting loses 2 points.
3. DVN SECURITY CONFIGURATION — Configures Decentralized Verifier Networks via setSendConfig/setReceiveConfig with explicit DVN addresses (e.g., Google Cloud DVN, Polyhedra). Understands requiredDVNs vs optionalDVNs and threshold. Default DVN without explicit config loses 2 points.
4. OPTIONS ENCODING — Uses @layerzerolabs/lz-v2-utilities OptionsBuilder for encoding executor options: addExecutorLzReceiveOption(gas, value), addExecutorNativeDropOption, addExecutorComposeOption. Hardcoded options bytes loses 2 points.
5. COMPOSED MESSAGING — For multi-step flows: implements lzCompose for composed message handling, uses sendCompose for chaining operations across contracts on the destination chain. Missing compose support when needed loses 1 point.
6. ADDRESS CONVERSION — Uses addressToBytes32 and bytes32ToAddress from @layerzerolabs/lz-v2-utilities for cross-chain address encoding (EVM 20-byte to 32-byte padding). Incorrect address encoding causes lost funds — missing conversion scores 0.
7. FEE ESTIMATION — Calls quoteSend or quote before _lzSend to estimate cross-chain messaging fees (nativeFee + lzTokenFee). Displays fee to user before transaction. Sending without fee quote loses 2 points.
8. ERROR HANDLING — Handles LayerZero-specific errors: InsufficientFee, InvalidEndpointCall, Unauthorized (peer not set), LzTokenUnavailable, message ordering failures. Generic try/catch loses 2 points.
9. PEER CONFIGURATION — Sets peers via setPeer(dstEid, peerAddress) for each connected chain. Validates peer addresses match deployed contracts. Missing peer setup causes silently dropped messages — no peer config scores 0.
10. PRODUCTION READINESS — Environment-based RPC URLs per chain, chain-specific endpoint IDs (30101=Ethereum, 30106=Avalanche, 30110=Arbitrum, 30111=Optimism), viem or ethers for contract interaction, message tracking via LayerZero Scan, proper loading states.

Score 0 if placeholder endpoint IDs or contract addresses are used.
Score 0 if private keys are hardcoded in source.
Score 0 if cross-chain messaging is simulated without LayerZero contract calls.

leaves.name: LayerZero OFT multi-chain token launch platform
leaves.description: A no-code platform for launching OFT tokens across multiple chains simultaneously. Wizard: configure token name/symbol/supply, select target chains, choose mint distribution (which chains get initial supply). Deploy OFT contracts on each chain, call setPeer() to wire all pairs, set enforcedOptions with minimum gas for lzReceive. Configure DVN security stack per pathway. Post-launch: rate-limit dashboard and transfer analytics.
